verdicts.reason: The two are almost pixel-identical, so I called it a tie. Both flip the hierarchy: the secondary line 'food & drinks' is set much larger than the 'Order online' headline. In both, 'drinks' runs over the busy kraft-box photo, a single divider rule floats on top of the boxes and the other rule is gone. The headline is also cramped on the left, leaving a dead strip in the middle. Candidate B's subtitle sits a few pixels further left, which changes nothing.
